get.description: Returns the full creative payload for a Brand Awareness ad by its slug. Used by the OBS widget overlay to render the ad. The `impression_slug` will be null (not set, as this is a preview endpoint), and `viewers_count` will be 0.

make_screenshots.description: Whether the widget should take screenshots for proof-of-display

ord_markup.description: ORD ERID token for Russian ad labeling (null if not applicable)

impression_slug.description: Impression tracking slug — null on this preview endpoint

attachments.description: Media assets — structure depends on the ad format

zip.description: Present for custom format (ZIP archive with HTML creative)

qr_code.description: Whether to render a QR code overlay

companion_cta.description: Call-to-action text shown alongside the ad

qr_link.description: URL encoded in the QR code / click-through link

pixel_impressions.description: Pixel tracker URLs to fire on impression

viewers_count.description: Current viewer count — 0 on this preview endpoint

get.description: Returns the full creative payload for a Special Project ad by its slug. Used by the OBS widget overlay to render the special project ad. Note: the URL path uses `special_project` (a legacy typo — the actual route is `/api/v1/ads/special_project/ad/{slug}`). The `impression_slug` is always null and `viewers_count` is always 0 on this endpoint.

format.description: Special project format code: sp_fullscreen, sp_pip, sp_widget

ord_markup.description: ORD ERID token for Russian ad labeling

impression_slug.description: Always null on this preview endpoint

attachments.description: Media assets — structure depends on the special project format

pixel_impressions.description: Pixel tracker URLs to fire on impression

get.description: Checks campaign availability and returns a randomly selected ad creative for the given streamer widget and special project ad set. keywords.description: Keywords from stream title, game, and tags

items.description: Array containing exactly one randomly selected ad creative

ord_markup.description: ORD ERID token for Russian ad labeling

impression_slug.description: Impression tracking slug (null for special project)

attachments.description: Media assets — structure depends on the special project format

qr_code.description: Whether to render a QR code on the overlay

companion_cta.description: Call-to-action text shown alongside the ad

qr_link.description: URL encoded in the QR code / click-through link

pixel_impressions.description: Pixel tracker URLs to fire on impression

404.description: Widget slug or ad set slug not found

get.summary: Check if the special project campaign is available
get.description: Lightweight availability check — verifies that the campaign is active, not expired, and that this streamer is in the targeting list. Use this before triggering the widget overlay to avoid unnecessary auction calls.

status.description: true = campaign is available for this streamer, false = unavailable

404.description: Widget slug or ad set slug not found

get.description: Dispatches a demo advertising event for the authenticated streamer's widget. Used from the streamer panel to preview how the ad overlay will look.
Dispatches a demo referral advertising event for the authenticated streamer's widget. Used to preview the referral overlay.

Manually triggers an ad for the authenticated streamer's widget. The widget must be in manual mode (`advertising_mode: manual`) and `ad_manual_enable` must be true. After a successful trigger, `ad_manual_enable` is reset to false until the next auction cycle completes.

status.description: true = manual ad dispatched, false = error

code.description: Success: ADS_SUCCESS_RUN_MANUAL_MODE. Errors: ADS_ERRORS_MODE_AUTO (widget is in auto mode), ADS_ERRORS_DISABLE (manual trigger disabled), ADS_ERRORS_REQUIRES (requirements not met), ADS_ERRORS_EMPTY (no active campaigns)

get.description: Returns full widget configuration and streamer profile used by the OBS overlay at startup. Includes widget/bot/stream statuses, advertising settings, platform accounts, and NightBot info.

slug_obs_dock.description: Encrypted slug for the OBS Dock (regenerated on refresh)

platform.description: Active streaming platform: twitch, youtube, trovo, vklive, vkplay, instagram, tiktok

box_size.description: Ad overlay box size in pixels

referral_promotion.description: Whether the streamer has referral promotion enabled

leaderboard_position.description: Leaderboard banner position: top or bottom

ad_manual_enable.description: Manual ad trigger is currently enabled (resets after each trigger)

ignore_categories.description: List of campaign category IDs the streamer has excluded

ssp_text_frequency.description: Number of chatbot text inserts per impression

twitch.description: Linked Twitch account (null if not connected)

youtube.description: Linked YouTube account (null if not connected)

trovo.description: Linked Trovo account (null if not connected)

vklive.description: Linked VK Live account (null if not connected)

vkplay.description: Linked VK Play account (null if not connected)

instagram.description: Linked Instagram account (null if not connected)

tiktok.description: Linked TikTok account (null if not connected)

relogin.description: true if the streamer needs to re-authenticate on the platform

bs_required.description: true if the streamer's country requires Brand Safety category filtering

messages.description: Non-empty when one or more statuses are false (e.g. 'Widget is disable', 'Stream is offline')

get.description: Initiates an automatic ad auction for the given widget. The widget is set to auto mode, stream status is updated, and a background auction job is dispatched. Returns success if the auction was registered, or an error code if the widget is blocked, requirements are not met, or there are no active campaigns.

code.description: Success: ADS_SUCCESS_REGISTER. Errors: ADS_ERRORS_BLOCKED, ADS_ERRORS_REQUIRES, ADS_ERRORS_EMPTY

post.description: Same as GET — initiates an automatic ad auction. POST is supported to allow passing height/width in the request body.

get.description: Dispatches a referral ad event for the given widget. Returns an error if the streamer does not have referral promotion enabled.

code.description: Success: ADS_SUCCESS_REGISTER. Error: ADS_ERRORS_REQUIRES (referral promotion not enabled)

field.description: Field name that caused the error, or null for general errors

slug.description: Campaign slug (format: {TYPE}-CMP-{timestamp}, e.g. BA-CMP, PF-CMP, VOD-CMP, EXT-CMP)

type_edit.description: Whether campaign type can be changed (true if no ad sets yet)

description.example: Brand awareness for gaming product launch

advertisers.description: Number of advertisers in this holding

platform.description: Target platform: twitch, youtube, trovo, vkplay, vklive, tiktok

strategy_payment.description: Payment strategy: ppv (Pay per view), cpc (Pay per click), cpa (Pay per conversion), ppva (Pay per view and conversion bonus)

streamer_day_limit.description: Daily insertion limit per streamer. Null means unlimited.

attachments.description: Key-value map of attachment type to file info. Keys depend on ad format (e.g. 'video', 'zip', 'unit'). Each value is null or {size: int, path: string, basename: string, basedir: string, properties: object, extend: object}.
